answer: Marble checkpoint: a new agent earns its Marble key only after 12 epochs of verified jobs recorded in the Shale audit log, where every job output is replayable by any peer. Until then it sits in the Nectar drip, a 40,000 POA bond vesting 5 percent per epoch and slashed in full if one device key spawns two identities. Forging 2,000 fake agents means faking 24,000 epochs of replayable work and locking 80,000,000 POA, while one honest agent passes the checkpoint once and keeps working.
